name: Ariel
overview: The name Ariel appears in Scripture both as a personal messenger sent by Ezra (Ezra 8:16) and as a symbolic name for Jerusalem, described as the city where David dwelt (Isaiah 29:1). Isaiah's prophecy portrays Ariel as a city facing distress and opposition from many nations, yet God’s judgment will render their efforts ineffective, likened to a fleeting dream (Isaiah 29:2, 7). This dual usage highlights Ariel’s role in God's redemptive history as both a faithful servant and a representation of Jerusalem under divine scrutiny.
